statement: Model call location: The LLM model call happens in the client agent AFTER tools/list responses are received and BEFORE crafting the tools/call request; no LLM call happens inside the MCP server.

annotations_guide.id: Unique request/response sequence identifier matching client requests to server responses.
annotations_guide.params: Input parameters payload carrying client capabilities, tool names, or tool execution arguments.
annotations_guide.result: Server payload container returning protocol version, discovered tool schemas, or execution output.

exchange._comment_params: Negotiated protocol version and client metadata

exchange._comment_result: Server protocol version, server capabilities, and package-registry server metadata

exchange._comment_method: Notification acknowledging server readiness (no response expected)

exchange._comment_result: List of discovered MCP tools (get_package_versions, get_release_date, get_package_deprecation_notice) with JSON Schema input specs

tools.name: get_package_versions
tools.description: Query package registry for all published version metadata, latest release tag, and available release history for a given package name.

tools.name: get_release_date
tools.description: Query package registry to retrieve the exact release timestamp/date for a specific package name and version tag.

tools.name: get_package_deprecation_notice
tools.description: Query package registry for deprecation notices, end-of-life sunset warnings, and migration upgrade advice for a specific package version.

version.description: Version string to check (e.g. 2.1.0 or v2)

exchange._comment_params: Tool name ('get_package_deprecation_notice') and target arguments ({package_name: 'docs-sdk', version: '2.1.0'})

exchange._comment_result: Tool execution content array containing structured JSON response with deprecation notice

content.text:
{
  "tool": "get_package_deprecation_notice",
  "package_name": "docs-sdk",
  "version": "2.1.0",
  "is_deprecated": true,
  "deprecation_notice": "Version 2.1.0 is deprecated as of 2026-06-01. Migrate to v3.2.0 before mandatory sunset date.",
  "recommended_upgrade": "3.2.0"
}
